engine: PostgreSQL via PGlite; auth and storage APIs mocked, real RLS executed

tests.name: Signup ignores forged administrative metadata
No role self-promotion or approval from browser
Student can update only their own editable profile
Student and institution cannot read other tenant classes
Only institution can enroll their affiliated students
Student cannot publish jobs or mint XP rows
Prerequisite enforced; module completion idempotent
XP is server-graded and awarded once
Submission rejects forged grade and other student identity
Only responsible teacher/institution can grade
Candidate profile stays private until application
Experience ownership and candidate sharing are enforced
Application status permissions and withdrawal enforced
Post authors are stamped; users cannot forge another author
Chat only allows related accounts
Private storage denies other users documents
Certificate requires all modules and supervising staff
Anonymous cannot access private tables; verification is narrow
Support is private until explicit sharing with an affiliated teacher
MFA enforced by RLS and RPC, not only frontend
Unconfirmed email cannot read, write, call RPC or access private storage
Banned account cannot read, write, call RPC or access private storage
Anonymous account cannot read, write, call RPC or access private storage
Revoked session cannot read, write, call RPC or access private storage
Expired session cannot read, write, call RPC or access private storage
Session belonging to another account cannot read, write, call RPC or access private storage
Account without a provisioned role cannot use student RPCs
JWT without a session identifier is refused
Every exposed app table has RLS
